The '''Crystal Snake''' was a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Crystal Snake was piloting a [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] in the [[Karthakk system]] when they were defeated by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:AtRTdCS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempBlackSunSpaceComm.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of the Crystal Snake]]
The Crystal Snake appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AtRTdCS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystal Snake was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AtRTdCS" />
